# gittydocs

> Simple, fast docs from your Markdown.

Paths are site-relative. Use {origin}{path}, not /llms.txt{path}.
Per-page markdown lives at /llms/... by default.

## Table of Contents

### Docs
- [Introduction](/llms/introduction.md): Turn a GitHub folder of Markdown/MDX into a fast, searchable docs site.
- [Motivation](/llms/motivation.md): Why gittydocs exists.
- [AI Docs Prompt](/llms/ai-docs-prompt.md): Let an LLM write your docs for you with our llms.txt.
- [Configuration ⚙️](/llms/configuration.md): A reference for site metadata, versions, navigation and footer links, and content.
- [Navigation](/llms/navigation.md): Organize pages with nested groups, footer links, icons, and page navigation.
- [CLI](/llms/cli.md): Scaffold, develop, build, and deploy with the gittydocs CLI.
- [Theming](/llms/theming.md): Customize app.css, choose a preset, and add custom CSS.

### Components
- [Components](/llms/components/index.md): Built-in MDX components for steps, file trees, accordions, and code blocks.
- [Code blocks](/llms/components/code-blocks.md): Add syntax highlighting, filename headers, and copyable code with Markdown fences.
- Authoring
  - [Steps](/llms/components/steps.md): Present numbered instructions with the import-free Steps and Step components.
  - [Files](/llms/components/files.md): Display collapsible file trees with filename icons and optional descriptions.
  - [Accordion](/llms/components/accordion.md): Keep optional details in import-free expandable sections.

### Deploy
- [Deployment Overview](/llms/deploy/index.md): Pick a deployment path and understand the build output.
- [GitHub Pages 🚀](/llms/deploy/github-pages.md): Deploy your docs to GitHub Pages.
- [Vercel ▲](/llms/deploy/vercel.md): Deploy your docs to Vercel.
- [Cloudflare Pages ☁️](/llms/deploy/cloudflare.md): Deploy your docs to Cloudflare Pages.
- [Netlify 🌐](/llms/deploy/netlify.md): Deploy your docs to Netlify.
